azanReply.text: Repeat after the muadhin; for 'Hayya alas-Salah' and 'Hayya alal-Falah' say:
azanReply.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
azanReply.translation: There is no power nor might except with Allah

azanDua.title: Dua after the Azan
azanDua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
azanDua.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the Wasilah and honour, and raise him to the praised station You have promised him.

betweenReminder.text: Dua made between the Azan and Iqamah is not rejected — ask Allah for afiyah in this world and the Hereafter.

betweenDuas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
betweenDuas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.

sunnahReminder.text: Between every Azan and Iqamah there is a (voluntary) prayer for whoever wishes.

iqamahScreen.title: Straighten the rows
lines: Stand shoulder to shoulder and fill the gaps
Straightening the rows is part of perfecting the prayer (Bukhari 723)

salahScreen.line: Salah in progress — please remain silent

jumuahEtiquette.text: Perform ghusl and wear your best clothes
Send abundant salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ
When the Imam delivers the khutbah, remain completely silent

afterSalahAdhkar.text: Recite Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer
